sources.regulatory_source: Value Added Tax and Supplementary Duty Act 2012 (Act No. 47 of 2012) & NBR S.R.O. No. 186-AIN/2019/43-VAT
sources.notes: Mandatory issuance of Form Mushak-6.3 before goods depart premises.

sources.regulatory_source: Bangladesh Bank BRPD Circular No. 04 (2021) & SME & Special Programmes Department (SMESPD) Circular No. 02/2022
sources.notes: Enforces minimum DSCR of 1.25x and debt service cap of 40% monthly net income.
Caps microenterprise borrowing at BDT 1,500,000 without institutional collateral.

sources.regulatory_source: Measures for the Administration of Invoices of the PRC (中华人民共和国发票管理办法 - State Council Order No. 764)
sources.notes: Governs digital electronic fapiao (数电发票) formatting, tax classification codes, and anti-fraud verification.

sources.regulatory_source: Ministry of Finance and SAT Announcement No. 12 (2023) on Preferential Income Tax Policies for Small and Low-Profit Enterprises
sources.notes: Taxable income under 3M CNY taxed at an effective preferential rate of 5% through 2027.

sources.regulatory_source: PBOC Circular Yinfa [2021] No. 312 on Deepening Financial Services for Micro and Small Enterprises
sources.notes: Mandates transparent loan pricing tied to LPR benchmark. The 1.30x DSCR is a commercial banking underwriting covenant guideline under PBOC inclusive finance risk practices, treated as a configurable threshold assumption rather than a statutory statute.

sources.regulatory_source: Electronic Invoicing Regulation (Resolution No. 2-3-21) & ZATCA Integration Phase 2 Mandate
sources.notes: Mandates cryptographic stamping, UUID, and TLV-encoded Base64 QR code for all B2B and B2C invoices.

sources.regulatory_source: SAMA Responsible Lending Principles for Retail and SME Customers Circular No. 391000100
sources.notes: Enforces Debt Burden Ratio (DBR) / DTI caps and Murabaha / Tawaruq Islamic finance transparency.

sources.regulatory_source: A New Tax System (Goods and Services Tax) Act 1999, Section 29-70
